definitions.explanation: An electronic screen for displaying visual output from a computer, phone, or other device.
An arrangement of goods, artwork, or items for viewing, as in a shop window or museum.

examples.japanese: ディスプレー⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{暗|くら}い→暗い：00647_kurai⟧。
⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧ディスプレー⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
⟦{長時間|ちょうじかん}→長時間：10165_choujikan⟧ディスプレー⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}ている→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{疲|つか}れる→疲れる：00901_tsukareru⟧。

notes:
From English "display." In Japanese, both ⟦ディスプレイ→ディスプレイ：04891_disupurei⟧ and ディスプレー are used; the latter follows the traditional Japanese convention for long vowels in loanwords. The electronic screen sense is overwhelmingly more common in everyday conversation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ディスプレー⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧: to look at a display/screen
- ⟦{液晶|えきしょう}→液晶：16387_ekishou⟧ディスプレー: LCD display
- ⟦{外部|がいぶ}→外部：00052_gaibu⟧ディスプレー: external monitor
- ディスプレー⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{解像度|かいぞうど}→解像度：04888_kaizoudo⟧: display resolution
- ウィンドウディスプレー: window display (retail)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦モニター→モニター：05105_monitaa⟧: monitor — often interchangeable for the screen sense, but also means a person who monitors or tests something
- ⟦{画面|がめん}→画面：04406_gamen⟧: screen — refers to the screen surface or what is shown on it
- ⟦{展示|てんじ}→展示：12401_tenji⟧: exhibition, display — more formal term for the showcase sense
